ITEM 1 | Single rectangular slice with a golden-brown, charred bottom crust edge and a pale, lightly blistered crust; top covered with a bright red-orange tomato sauce layer, a round slice of tomato with pale seeded centre and red skin at its middle-left, and a few white cheese patches on the right side; slice about 7 cm long by 4 cm wide and roughly 1 cm thick, sitting on a white square plate with a small green herb leaf peeking out beside its right edge | 55

ITEM 2 | Small flat green herb leaf, dark green with slightly darker veins, lying partly under the right edge of the pizza slice and extending about 2 cm past it onto the plate; matte, dry surface | 2

ITEM 3 | Thin reddish-orange tomato sauce smear and residue on the plate surface beside the slice, barely visible, matte and dry with no pooling | 3
